traits.name: False Light
traits.desc: While motionless, the bog lantern looks like a lantern carried by a distant traveller.

actions.name: Searing Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) fire damage.

actions.name: Lure (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: One creature the bog lantern can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or use its next movement to move toward the bog lantern.

results.name: Lantern Mote
results.components: V, S, M (a pinch of ash)
results.description: A mote of light circles a creature you can see. Until the spell ends, attack rolls against that creature can't benefit from it being invisible.

results.name: Marsh Lantern
results.description: This hooded lantern sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius that also reveals footprints made in the last hour.
